about.subtitle: Learn about the Student Welfare Fund and our mission to support education
about.intro: The Student Welfare Fund operates under the Social Development Committee in the Wilayat of Ibra and aims to support eligible students in completing their higher education.
about.visionText: To effectively contribute to building an educated, enlightened generation that keeps pace with society's aspirations and contributes to its development.
about.missionText: To sustain and enhance higher education opportunities for eligible students from low-income families, supporting them to complete their university education and raise their academic level.
about.targetAudienceText: Students enrolled in university programs from families eligible for support in the Wilayat of Ibra.
about.accreditationText: Approved by the Ministry of Social Development.
about.objective1: To help and empower university students from eligible families, both financially and morally, to complete their university studies.
about.objective2: Direct assistance by covering some study costs such as tuition fees, housing, and transport.
about.objective3: To contribute to investing in human resources and building an educated society in line with Oman Vision 2040.
about.objective4: To provide a fund that supports education and helps raise the level of education among eligible families.
about.legalStatus1: Approved by the Ministry of Social Development.
about.legalStatus2: Operates under the umbrella of the Social Development Committee in the Wilayat of Ibra.
about.legalStatus3: Subject to the supervision of the approved Social Development Committee in the Wilayah.
about.legalStatus4: Complies with the regulations in force at the Ministry of Social Development.
about.legalStatus5: Has a bank account within the accounts of the Social Development Committee.
